away.summary: The Canucks (5-17-1) have won two straight games, including a 3-2 victory over Utah, and are looking to finish their three-game road trip on a high note. Brock Boeser is on an eight-game point streak, while Jonathan Lekkerimäki is playing in his 24th game, matching his career high. Thatcher Demko remains out with a hip injury, and Nikita Tolopilo has been reassigned to the AHL after making his season debut in Utah.

doubtful.detail: chest injury, 'super close' to a return and was a game-time decision for Saturday's game

home.summary: The Kraken (9-8-1) have dropped three straight games, including 4-1 and 5-1 losses to Carolina in Finland, and have the league's worst penalty kill at 62.7%. They are tied for the fewest games played in the league (18) and face a condensed schedule with 19 games in 41 days. Jared McCann and Curtis Douglas remain on injured reserve, while Jacob Melanson is nearing a return from a chest injury.
